business.title: What kind of business is hiring?
business.description: e.g. 'a café in Portland', 'a six-person design studio'.

tools.name: hiring_status
tools.description: The whole hiring desk: interviews coming up (with dates and interviewers), candidates interviewed but missing a scorecard, and every open role’s pipeline by stage with ids and average ratings. Call it first when asked who is interviewing, where a search stands, or how candidates compare.

tools.name: add_role
tools.description: Open a role or update one: title, the job-related requirements interviewers will rate (comma-separated), openings, hiring manager and pay. An existing title is updated, never duplicated. Call it as soon as a role is mentioned, before you describe it. Requirements are about the job only, never age, family, religion, health, origin or any other protected trait.

tools.name: add_candidate
tools.description: Add a candidate to a role’s pipeline: full name, role, where they came from, a short job-related note, and the interview date when one is already booked. An existing name in that role is updated, never duplicated. Call it as soon as a candidate is mentioned, before you describe them.

tools.name: move_candidate
tools.description: Move a candidate to the stage the person names (sourced, screen, interview, offer, hired or closed) and book the interview: interviewOn takes YYYY-MM-DD or a weekday like "thursday", which the desk turns into the date. Call it the moment the person asks. Never move anyone on your own judgment; hiring decisions are the person’s.

tools.name: log_feedback
tools.description: Record how an interview went: who interviewed, ratings from 1 to 4 on the role’s requirements (e.g. "Coffee and milk skills 3, Warm customer service 4"), and what the candidate said or did. Call it as soon as the person reports an interview, before you summarize it.

tools.name: list_candidates
tools.description: Every candidate with their role, stage, interview, average ratings and latest note.

tools.name: page_add_candidate
tools.description: Add a candidate to a role.

tools.name: page_move_candidate
tools.description: Move a candidate or book an interview.
